data.name: Faik
data.gender_notes: Faik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is trustworthy and reliable, one who has faith and is faithful to his promises. The name Faik carries the meaning “Trustworthy, reliable, faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faik usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, reliable, faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes trust, faith, and reliability in the divine plan and in oneself
data.etymology: Faik belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, reliable, faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faik total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فائق
in_arabic.meaning: فائق تعني متفوق أو متميز أو ذو جودة عالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فائق مشتق من الفاء والقاف والواو، و معناه في اللغة العربية: متفوق، متميز، أو ذو جودة عالية. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: ﴿وَيَقْضِي عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَلا يَأْمَنَ فائِقًا وَلا خَيفَةً ﴾ [الأعراف: ٣٩]. و يعتبر اسم فائق من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و العلو في الدين و الدنيا.

in_urdu.name: فائق
in_urdu.meaning: فائق کا مطلب ہے ممتاز، متفوق، یا اعلیٰ معیار کا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فائق ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ممتاز، متفوق، یا اعلیٰ معیار کا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ فاء، قاف، واو سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کا ذکر کئی بار آیا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن مجید میں۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ العلو و رفعت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फाइक
in_hindi.meaning: फाइक का अर्थ है उत्कृष्ट, श्रेष्ठ, या उच्च गुणवत्ता
in_hindi.long_meaning: फाइक एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है उत्कृष्ट, श्रेष्ठ, या उच्च गुणवत्ता। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों फा, काफ, वाव से लिया गया है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह उच्चता और उत्कृष्टता को दर्शाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है।

in_pashto.name: فائق
in_pashto.meaning: فائق د دې معنی دی چی لوړ، ستر، او يا ښه کیفیت لرونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فائق نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او د معنی یې لوړ، ستر، او يا ښه کیفیت لرونکی دی. دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې د احترام او لوړتیا د څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي. په پښتو ژبه کې، دا نوم د دیني او ثقافتي اهمیت له مخې ځانګړی دی.

in_english.name: Faik
in_english.meaning: Faik means excellent, superior, or of high quality

This name has been mentioned in the Quran and holds significance in Islamic tradition as it denotes elevation and excellence. The name Faik is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing high moral and spiritual standards.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Faik" is of Arabic origin and is popular among Muslims, particularly those who follow the Turkish cultural tradition. It is a strong and memorable name, meaning "trustworthy" or "reliable." In Turkish culture, a reliable and trustworthy person is highly valued, and the name "Faik" can be seen as a badge of honor, signifying one's character and integrity. This name can also be found in other Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Faik" is deeply rooted in Islamic values and teachings. In Islam, faithfulness and trustworthiness are emphasized, and the name "Faik" can be seen as a reflection of these values. Belief in God and fulfilling promises made to Him and to others are essential parts of Muslim religious practice. A person with the name "Faik" can be seen as a virtuous person who values the trust and faith placed in him by others and strives to be deserving of that trust. Ultimately, the name "Faik" is a reminder of the importance of being faithful and trustworthy, not only to others but also to oneself and to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Trustworthy, reliable, faithful" symbolizes One who is trustworthy and reliable, one who has faith and is faithful to his promises. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Faik serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of trustworthy, reliable, faithful.
